cards.title: Turn on saving from the site
cards.plain: The site can save your picks (and your Decisions answers) without a Vercel deploy, but it needs a private GitHub repo and a key that only you can make: 3 steps in tools/review_site/README.md ("Saving without a deploy"), then one Redeploy.
cards.why: Until then, Decisions answers on the site fall back to copying a line for the PC chat, and new renders still go out as Vercel deploys.

options.label: Walk me through it now
options.note: the PC chat opens each page in the browser; you paste the key

cards.title: Which jar models get 3D next?
cards.plain: The 3D catalogue only has the Dark Lantern so far. The other 79 jar models get 3D one batch at a time, the ones you pick (each batch is one site deploy).
cards.why: Lets you spin the models in 3D before you pick what to build from them.

cards.title: Does the Dark Lantern swirl show now?
